wargear.name: Carapace breastplate
wargear.summary: Ceramite-laminate plate issued to Primes and officers who have earned it.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Carapace breastplate has a Save Characteristic of 3+, unless its Save Characteristic is already better.

wargear.name: Bulwark field-cloak
wargear.summary: A shimmering cloak woven with a deflector mesh, worn by officers who expect to be shot at.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Bulwark field-cloak has an Invulnerable Save of 4+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Veteran Prime
wargear.summary: A Prime who has marched through three theatres and never lost a standard.
wargear.text: A Model upgraded to a Veteran Prime adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill and Initiative Characteristics.

wargear.name: Cohort colours
wargear.summary: The tercio's battle-honours, stitched into a banner that every trooper can see.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Cohort colours, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics.

wargear.name: Charonite bastion-plate
wargear.summary: Riveted slabs of charonite alloy bolted over an Ogryn's chest and shoulders.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Charonite bastion-plate has a Save Characteristic of 3+, unless its Save Characteristic is already better.

wargear.name: Applique plating
wargear.summary: Spare armour plate welded on in the field.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Applique plating adds 1 to its Hull Points Characteristic.

wargear.name: Siege plating
wargear.summary: Thick glacis slabs and track skirts for crawling into a prepared line.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Siege plating adds 1 to its Front Armour Value and subtracts 2 from its Movement Characteristic.

wargear.name: Fire-control cogitator
wargear.summary: A cogitator rack that works out the arc before the gun is laid.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Fire-control cogitator adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

wargear.name: Abjuration talisman
wargear.summary: A tarnished ward-charm blessed by a Lodge priest and worn under the greatcoat.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Abjuration talisman adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic and has the Mind Ward Special Rule.

wargear.name: Aquila signum-pole
wargear.summary: A gilded pole topped with the Aquila, planted where the line must hold.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with an Aquila signum-pole, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Cool Characteristic and have the Beacon of the Line Special Rule.

wargear.name: Wall-cracker's satchel
wargear.summary: A satchel of shaped sapper charges.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Wall-cracker's satchel has the Wall-Cracker Special Rule.

wargear.name: Pathfinder beacon
wargear.summary: A bright homing lamp carried by the lead scout of a Hermes pack.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Pathfinder beacon, all Models in that Unit have the Trail Marker Special Rule.

wargear.name: Rampart ram-prow
wargear.summary: A heavy cast-iron prow bolted over the glacis.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Rampart ram-prow has the Rampart Ploughshare Special Rule.

wargear.name: Obscurant flare mortars
wargear.summary: Roof-mounted mortars that throw a screen of reflective chaff and vapour.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Obscurant flare mortars has the Shrouded (6+) and Obscurant Veil Special Rules.

wargear.name: Brass signal whistle
wargear.summary: A sergeant's whistle whose note carries over the roar of a battle.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Brass signal whistle, all Models in that Unit have the Sound the Advance Special Rule.

modifiers.text: Volley drill: +1 BS while the unit did not move in its last Movement Phase.
modifiers.condition: while the unit did not move in its last Movement Phase

modifiers.text: Volley drill: -1 WS. Drilled to hold a line, not to fight on it.
Veteran tank crews: +1 BS, -1 Rear armour.
Aquila signum-pole: +1 CL, Beacon of the Line.
Obscurant flare mortars: Obscurant Veil, Shrouded (6+).
Brass signal whistle: Sound the Advance.

rules.name: Sealed Plate
rules.summary: Sealed against gas, flame and fear alike.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule ignores the Pinning (X) and Panic (X) Special Rules of Weapons used against it, and Suppressive (X) has no effect on it.

rules.name: Spearhead Column
rules.summary: The tanks break from the line and drive deep before the foe has settled.
rules.text: During the first Battle Turn, a Model with this Special Rule that Rushes may still make a Shooting Attack with one of its Weapons, using its full Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: Forward the Breakers
rules.summary: The Ogryn have one order, and they have heard it.
rules.text: After both Players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, each Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule may make a Set-up Move of up to 6". It cannot end that move within 9" of any enemy Model. In any Battle Turn in which a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Charge, it ignores the Pinning (X) and Panic (X) Special Rules of Weapons used against it.

rules.name: Registered Fire
rules.summary: The park has ranged this ground for hours.
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack against an enemy Unit that another friendly Unit with this Special Rule has already made a Shooting Attack against in the same Phase, all Models in the firing Unit add 1 to the result of their Hit Tests.

rules.name: Armoured Wave
rules.summary: The Dracosans race ahead of the line and disgorge their cargo at the wall.
rules.text: If a Model with this Special Rule Rushes during the first Battle Turn, Units Embarked upon it may still Disembark after it has moved and declare a Charge in that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Mind Ward
rules.summary: A tarnished ward-charm and a whispered litany keep the warp at arm's length.
rules.text: The first Wound allocated to a Model with this Special Rule by a Psychic Power in each Phase is discarded.

rules.name: Beacon of the Line
rules.summary: The Aquila is planted, and the line forms around it.
rules.text: While at least one Model with this Special Rule is in a Unit and that Unit is within 6" of an Objective Marker, each Model in the Unit counts as two Models when determining which Unit Controls that Objective.

rules.name: Wall-Cracker
rules.summary: A satchel of shaped sapper charges, placed where the wall is weakest.
rules.text: Once per battle, a Model with this Special Rule may choose one of its Melee Attacks against a Vehicle or a Structure. That attack's Weapon has the Armourbane and Breaching (4+) Special Rules.

rules.name: Trail Marker
rules.summary: A homing lamp that tells the reserves exactly where the fight is.
rules.text: A friendly Unit that arrives from Reserves may be set up wholly within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule, even if it would not otherwise be able to arrive there, and suffers no penalty for arriving in this way.

rules.name: Rampart Ploughshare
rules.summary: A cast-iron prow that clears barricades and bodies alike.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule does not take Dangerous Terrain Tests for moving across Barricades and Walls. When it moves through an enemy Unit, that Unit suffers D3 additional Hits.

rules.name: Obscurant Veil
rules.summary: A screen of reflective chaff and vapour confuses the gunners' ranging.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks made with Weapons that have the Ordnance (X) or Barrage (X) Special Rules.

rules.name: Sound the Advance
rules.summary: A whistle-note that carries over the roar of battle and drags men back to their feet.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Unit with this Special Rule fails a Panic Check, the Controlling Player may choose to treat it as passed instead.

rites.name: Void-Armoured Tercios
rites.flavor: They crossed the dark between worlds in sealed plate, and they will cross a battlefield the same way.

modifiers.text: Void-Armoured Tercios: Line (1), Feel No Pain (6+), Sealed Plate.

require.note: The Rite needs at least two Veletaris Sections.

rites.text: They crossed the dark between worlds in sealed plate, and they will cross a battlefield the same way.
benefits: Veletaris Storm, Vanguard and Raider Sections may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Feel No Pain (6+).
Those sections gain Sealed Plate: they ignore the Pinning (X) and Panic (X) Special Rules of Weapons used against them, and Suppressive (X) has no effect on them.
limitations: At least two Veletaris Sections are required.
No Charonite Ogryn Sections or Aethon Heavy Sentinels, and no Lord of War units.

rites.name: The Armoured Fist
rites.flavor: The infantry are there to hold the ground the tanks have just taken.

modifiers.text: The Armoured Fist: Line (1), Outflank, Spearhead Column.

rites.text: The infantry are there to hold the ground the tanks have just taken.
benefits: Leman Russ, Malcador, Valdor, Destroyer and Thunderer tanks may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those tanks gain Outflank and Spearhead Column: during the first Battle Turn a tank that Rushes may still make a Shooting Attack with one of its Weapons at its full Ballistic Skill.
limitations: At least three of those tanks are required.
No more than one Lasrifle Section, and no Veletaris Sections.

rites.name: Charonite Breaker Host
rites.flavor: The Ogryn do not understand tactics. They do understand the word 'forward'.

modifiers.text: Charonite Breaker Host: Fear (1), Forward the Breakers.

require.note: Bring at least one Charonite Ogryn Section.

rites.text: The Ogryn do not understand tactics. They do understand the word 'forward'.
benefits: Charonite Ogryn Sections may fill Troops slots and gain Fear (1).

They gain Forward the Breakers: a free 6" Set-up Move before the first Battle Turn (ending more than 9" from the enemy), and they ignore Pinning (X) and Panic (X) in any Battle Turn in which they Charge.
limitations: At least one Charonite Ogryn Section is required.
No more than one tank from the Armour slots.
No Basilisk, Medusa or Rapier units and no Fast Attack units.
Table-top: a Charonite Ogryn Section that can charge must charge the nearest enemy unit it can reach.

rites.name: The Ordnance Park
rites.flavor: A regiment's real argument is made four kilometres behind its front line.

modifiers.condition: if the unit did not move in its last Movement phase

require.note: An Artillery Command Section directs the park.
At least two Basilisk, Medusa or Minotaur tanks.

rites.text: A regiment's real argument is made four kilometres behind its front line.
benefits: Basilisk and Medusa Artillery Tanks may fill Troops slots.

Basilisk, Medusa, Minotaur and Rapier units gain Registered Fire: +1 to Hit Tests against a target another Registered Fire Unit has already shot at in the same Phase. Rapier Sections that did not move also add 1 to their Ballistic Skill; the tanks already gain this from Armoured Doctrine.
limitations: An Artillery Command Section and at least two Basilisk, Medusa or Minotaur tanks are required.
No Recon and no Fast Attack units.

rites.name: Dracosan Assault Wave
rites.flavor: Every tercio rides, and every Dracosan lands within a pistol-shot of the wall.

modifiers.text: Dracosan Assault Wave: +2 M, Assault Vehicle, Armoured Wave.

rites.text: Every tercio rides, and every Dracosan lands within a pistol-shot of the wall.
benefits: Dracosan Armoured Transports and Command Dracosans gain +2 Movement, Assault Vehicle and Outflank.
They gain Armoured Wave: if a Dracosan Rushes in the first Battle Turn, its passengers may still Disembark and declare a Charge that turn.
limitations: At least two Dracosans are required.
No artillery tanks, no Rapier Sections and no Lord of War units.
Table-top: any Lasrifle or Veletaris Section that fits aboard a Dracosan must start the battle embarked.

armyRules.name: Massed Volley
armyRules.flavor: The Auxilia win by weight of las-fire.
benefits: When a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack against an enemy Unit that another Unit with this Special Rule has already made a Shooting Attack against in the same Phase, all Models in the firing Unit add 1 to their Ballistic Skill Characteristic for that attack.
drawbacks: The benefit above is lost if the Unit moved more than half its Movement Characteristic in its last Movement Phase.
A Unit with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of any Charge Roll it makes.
armyRules.condition: when shooting at a unit another Massed Volley unit already shot this phase

armyRules.name: Orders Down the Line
armyRules.flavor: A regiment is only as steady as its officers.
benefits: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of a friendly Command Unit, all Models in it add 1 to the result of Hit Tests they make as part of a Reaction.
drawbacks: If a Unit with this Special Rule has lost its Sergeant or Command Model as a casualty, it cannot declare Advanced Reactions for the rest of the battle.
armyRules.condition: when making a Reaction within 12" of a friendly Command unit

armyRules.name: Armoured Doctrine
armyRules.flavor: The tank parks fight as a gun line.
benefits: A Vehicle with this Special Rule that did not move in its last Movement Phase adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.
drawbacks: A Vehicle with this Special Rule that moved more than half its Movement Characteristic in its last Movement Phase subtracts 1 from the result of its Hit Tests.
armyRules.condition: if the vehicle did not move
